Message:
usb: typec: tcpm: queue correct sop type in tcpm_queue_vdm_unlocked

tcpm_queue_vdm_unlocked queues VDMs over SOP regardless of input
parameter tx_sop_type. Fix tcpm_queue_vdm() call.
